task: Welcome to another exciting game of TextWorld! First of all, travel south. After that, take a trip south. Next, attempt to venture west. And then, move north. Then, try to move west. Next, attempt to venture north. Then, recover the stick of butter from the floor of the closet. Alright, thanks!
description:
Fancy seeing you here. Here, by the way, being the washroom. Let's see what's in here.



You need an unblocked exit? You should try going north. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going south. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.

thought: I will follow the instructions and travel south first.
feedback:
You arrive in a study. A standard one.

You scan the room for a box, and you find a box. Now why would someone leave that there? What a letdown! The box is empty!

You need an unguarded exit? You should try going east. There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unblocked. There is an unguarded exit to the south. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

There is a butterfly on the floor.
